load_policies.ALWAYS: Load at thread start. Stable bootstrap and the assigned execution projection only.
load_policies.REQUIRED: Load before the first task command because it is necessary for objective, authority, scope or validation.
load_policies.FILTERED: Load only matching records or sections selected by explicit IDs, paths, surfaces or incident fingerprints.
load_policies.ON_TRIGGER: Load only after the declared observable trigger occurs.
load_policies.AUDIT_ONLY: Reserve for an independent validation or audit thread.
load_policies.HISTORICAL_REFERENCE: Use only for contradiction, provenance or challenged claims.
load_policies.FORBIDDEN: Must not be accessed under the current envelope.
